ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 60% high-intensity (cream/white) to 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity zones on both lobes. Central low-intensity black field originating from the notch and peduncle. Large tan/yellowish elliptical blob (approx. 10% of lobe area) located in the mid-right lobe. Black pigmentation fringes the trailing edge and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated pixel angle of 48 degrees and a depth extending approximately 18% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the entire trailing boundary; serration amplitudes vary from 5 to 15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the inner lobe edges near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve with a significant upward sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Four distinct circular high-contrast white rosettes (scarring) located in the black pigmentation zone of the right lobe. Dense clusters of white calcareous barnacles localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical dark linear disruption on the right lobe's white expanse. Multiple faint, unaligned grey scratches on the ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on both distal tips; large asymmetrical tan-colored patch on the right lobe representing unique pigmentation or biological staining.
other_distinctive_markers: Structural irregularities on the outer tips caused by dense barnacle encrustation and a prominent vertical black line on the right lobe.
